text:
#!name=闲鱼
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = acs.m.goofish.com, g-acs.m.goofish.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idlemtopsearch\.item\.search\.activate\/2\.0/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idlemtopsearch\.search\.discover\/1\.0/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.item\.resell\.recommendorhotcate\/1\.0/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idlehome\.idle\.coin\.nextfresh\/1\.0/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.item\.buy\.feeds/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.playboy\.recommend\/1\.0/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idlecommerce\.splash\.ads/i then reject_dict(200)
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idlemtopsearch\.search\.shade\//i then response.json.jq("del(.data)")
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.user\.strategy\.list\//i then response.json.jq("del(.data)")
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.group\.myself\.banner\//i then response.json.jq(".data.bannerList = []")
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.playboy\.recommend\/2\.0/i then response.json.jq(".data.recommends = [] | .data.items = [] | .data.next = false")
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.item\.recommend\.list\//i then response.json.jq(".data.cardList = []")
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.fun\.follow\.often\.visit/i then response.json.jq(".data.sections = []")
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.circle\.myself\.banner\/1\.0/i then response.json.jq(".data.bannerList = []")
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.circle\.visited\/1\.0/i then response.json.jq(".data.visitedCircleList = []")

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/(g-)?acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idlehome\.home\.nextfresh\//i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ishowshu/qx/refs/heads/main/script/goofish.js") with tag="商品信息流广告", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/(g-)?acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.local\.home\//i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ishowshu/qx/refs/heads/main/script/goofish.js") with tag="定位地区页面的信息流广告", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.idle\.user\.page\.my\.adapter\//i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ishowshu/qx/refs/heads/main/script/goofish.js") with tag="个人主页", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idlehome\.home\.circle\.list\/1\.0/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ishowshu/qx/refs/heads/main/script/goofish.js") with tag="首页顶部频道菜单", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.local\.nearby\.itemdetail\.enter\/1\.0/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ishowshu/qx/refs/heads/main/script/goofish.js") with tag="商品详情页周边推荐", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/g-acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idlemtopsearch\.search\//i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ishowshu/qx/refs/heads/main/script/goofish.js") with tag="搜索结果信息流广告", requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/acs\.m\.goofish\.com\/gw\/mtop\.taobao\.idle\.local\.flow\.plat\.section/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ishowshu/qx/refs/heads/main/script/goofish.js") with tag="同城页横幅广告", requires_body=true
